description: This file contains definitions for specific Subaru trigger decoders used in engine management, including trigger initialization functions for certain Subaru models. It defines trigger shapes and event timings for sensor signals, relevant for engine ignition timing.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: A class representing the trigger signal shape used in engine synchronization

methods.name: void initialize36_2_2_2(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for a Subaru engine with a specific cam sensor pattern involving multiple events spaced by narrow and wide angles, used for synchronization

methods.name: void initializeSubaru7_6(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for another Subaru engine with a complex sequence of primary and secondary events based on specific timing values
